question: P and Q together can fill a tank with water in 12 hours. If P alone can fill the tank with water in 30 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill one-fourth of the same tank with water?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

P + Q = 1/12 and P = 1/30

So Q = (1/12 − 1/30)

LCM 60 ⇒ Q = 3/60 = 1/20

Q fills full tank in 20 hours ⇒ 1/4 tank in 20 ÷ 4

**∴ Answer = 5 hours**
